rows.label: Neuroptics Blueprint
rows.note: 60 kills of the vessel's target, then ~50 Feral Kavats

conditions: Kills only count while Sands of Inaros is your active quest. If a vessel stalls, clear other active quests and reactivate this one from the Codex.
Each player gets a random target per vessel; check the glyph on the vessel by the Orbiter's Codex desk. Low Effects Intensity can hide it.
The quest can't be replayed, and a second key does not reset it. Farm Kavat codes on the second visit before killing them all.
bonuses: The second tomb visit is the best one-time Kavat Genetic Code farm in the game.
Systems also awards the Sacred Vessel orbiter decoration.

disclosures.title: Kavat code setup
disclosures.body: Bring Ivara with Prowl or a sleep Equinox, a Synthesis Scanner with Vector-Thread, Cross-Matrix and Sol-Battery, and a Resource Booster plus Resource Drop Chance Booster. A fully charged Ballistica kill spawns a scannable specter, so each Kavat scans twice. Scan and kill one at a time, and don't arm your companion. Hauls range from 3 to 142 codes. Aborting discards that attempt's codes but lets you retry.

disclosures.title: where to find vessel targets
disclosures.body: Bursa: fail a Robotic Onslaught conduit in a Corpus Disruption like Laomedeia, Neptune. Juggernaut: Magnacidium, Deimos spawns one 75-90% of the time; kill and abort, kills still count. Manic: Tyl Regor on Titania, Uranus. Hyekka Master: Helene, Hydron or Stöfler. Seeker: Spear, Mars. Brood Mother: any Infested node on Eris or Deimos. Hazard and Simulacrum kills never count.

disclosures.title: tomb bosses
disclosures.body: The Tomb Guardian splits each time it dies; bring area damage like Penta or Tonkor, and Molecular Prime carries over to the splits. The Tomb Protector copies your frame and primary, so equip a weak primary and don't be in Operator form when it spawns. Breaking line of sight stops shadows spawning, and you can lure it into the flooded side rooms. The fight has a ~15-minute timer.

disclosures.title: other sources
disclosures.body: After The Duviri Paradox, Inaros is week 8 of the Normal Circuit: Neuroptics tier 2, Chassis 5, Systems 8, main 10 (3,640 progress, ~23 stages). After the quest, Cephalon Simaris sells replacements at 25,000 standing a part and 50,000 for the main blueprint.
